page.overview:
Who is Shemerin?

Shemerin is plump. She never mastered the outward calmness of the Aes Sedai and so always has a look of strained anxiety in her eyes.

She is a coward, and knows she is. Many sisters thought she was unsuitable to be Aes Sedai, even before Elaida demoted her.

Shemerin is strong in the One Power, with a level of . While there are Aes Sedai stronger in the Power, there are not many. In fact, among the Yellow Ajah we have details on, only Romanda Cassin is stronger and only Desandre Alraed is her equal.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she is regarded as a good Healer.
